240-1115-5470-8249.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

255-3259-8201.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
255-3259-8201.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Stangg as attackers.
Stangg triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1477-2073-7877-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Voyager Glidecar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Voyager Glidecar enters, it and Kolodin trigger.
Resolve the Voyager Glidecar trigger, causing you to scry 1
Resolve the Kolodin trigger, causing Voyager Glidecar to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Voyager Glidecar.
When Voyager Glidecar dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

301-5961-7860.description:
Activate Mogg Raider by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Uncivil Unrest.
Resolve the Mogg Raider ability.
Repeat.

1987-3277-6573.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-3277-6573.notablePrerequisites: You've cast a commander from the command zone two or more times this game.
1987-3277-6573.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Izzet Chronarch.
When Izzet Chronarch enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-3277-6573.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1987-2510-4477.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
1987-2510-4477.notablePrerequisites: There is an instant card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
1987-2510-4477.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2510-4477.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

4997-5929-7414.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
4997-5929-7414.description:
Draw a card.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pensive Professor.
Pensive Professor triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

3519-4477-7182.description:
Cast Greenwarden of Murasa for its evoke cost by paying {4}.
When Greenwarden of Murasa enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Greenwarden of Murasa.
When Greenwarden of Murasa dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa with haste.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters, it triggers, returning Greenwarden of Murasa from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Food Chain by exiling the Greenwarden of Murasa, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}{B} that can only be spent to cast creature spells.
Repeat.

341-3532-5078-6822.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1473-5641-5870.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying its mana cost.
When Basking Broodscale enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Fabrication Module triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to get {E} and gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

339-677-2921-4885.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

678-4192-5659-5753-6797.easyPrerequisites: "Lhurgoyf" chosen with Ashes of the Fallen.
678-4192-5659-5753-6797.description:
Discard Circling Vultures from your hand using its static ability.
Because Circling Vultures is a Lhurgoyf due to Ashes of the Fallen, Disa the Restless's first ability triggers, putting Circling Vultures from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Circling Vultures.
When Circling Vultures dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Circling Vultures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

3054-4050-4976.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
3054-4050-4976.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire, adding {B}.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Open the Graves triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {1}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

6575-6617.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra and with a lore counter on it.
Esper Terra triggers, creating a copy of The Apprentice's Folly and causing it to enter the battlefield with a lore counter on it.
The Apprentice's Folly's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Esper Terra that isn't legendary with a lore counter on it.
When the Esper Terra token enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of itself with haste and four lore counters on it.
When the Esper Terra token enters the battlefield, its first, second, third and fourth chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the first and second trigger, creating token copies of any nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the fourth trigger, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G} and exile the Esper Terra token.
Resolve the third trigger, creating a token copy of the Esper Terra token created in step 4 with haste and four lore counters on it.
Repeat from step 5.
6575-6617.notes: You can choose to have the tokens enter with one to three counters instead to get infinite creature tokens with haste.

586-2292-5258-5618-6556.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {1}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

654-1479-5700-5701-6528.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
654-1479-5700-5701-6528.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Elfsworn Giant trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Elfsworn Giant and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Elfsworn Giant triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1322-1563-2457-4094.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
1322-1563-2457-4094.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1770-2043-6252.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Boommobile that is a 1/1 Soldier artifact creature.
When the Boommobile token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding {8} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
1770-2043-6252.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate a Boommobile to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

224-654-2157-5954.notablePrerequisites: Romana II does not have summoning sickness.
224-654-2157-5954.description:
Cast Overlord of the Hauntwoods by paying {3}{G}{G}.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Reoslve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the Everywhere token.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Romana II.
Activate the Everywhere token by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Romana II by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a tapped copy of the Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 3.

3688-5478-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
3688-5478-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
3688-5478-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating an untapped Everywhere land token due to Spelunking.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zhur-Taa Ancient triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

152-2092-5034.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 5 or greater.
152-2092-5034.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying at most {2}, creating a token copy of Sol Ring.
Activate the Sol Ring token by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
If Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 6 or greater, this combo nets infinite mana and you can then target any other artifact(s) using Cogwork Assembler.

2051-2546-2657-3178.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two additional land cards in hand.
2051-2546-2657-3178.description:
Activate Forgotten Cave's cycling ability by paying {R} and discarding it.
 Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Forgotten Cave ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Ayula's Influence by discarding a land card.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Ayula's Influence ability, creating a 2/2 Bear creature token.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate the three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}{G}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning Forgotten Cave and two other lands from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2-1283-1651-1770.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken noncreature artifact with mana value one or less.
2-1283-1651-1770.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding at least {5}.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Clock of Omens by tapping the nontoken noncreature artifact with mana value one or less and by tapping Ancestral Statue, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve both Ancestral Statue triggers, returning it and the nontoken noncreature artifact to your hand.
Cast the noncreature artifact by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the noncreature artifact has a mana value of zero, this combo nets infinite mana, which would allow you to instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards.

1309-1636-3443-3566-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Deathbloom Ritualist does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least three creature cards in your graveyard.
1309-1636-3443-3566-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Salvager of Secrets, causing target player to mill cards equal to Salvager of Secrets's power.
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Twilight's Call by paying {4}{B}{B}, causing each player to return all creature cards from their graveyard to the battlefield.
Salvager of Secrets and each creature enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm that many times and Salvager of Secrets once.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nontoken creature, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, causing you to return Twilight's Call from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding at least one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 7 for each remaining trigger.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another nontoken creature, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat step 10 until you have at least six creature cards in your graveyard.
Repeat.

1183-2034-2744.notablePrerequisites: Pentavus has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1183-2034-2744.description:
Activate Pentavus' first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
The Pentavite enters the battlefield, triggering Cathars' Crusade, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Pentavite, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

802-2649-3821-4615.notablePrerequisites: You control up to four lands that can produce {1}{W/U}{R}{R}.
802-2649-3821-4615.description:
Cast Vadrok for its mutate cost by paying {1}{W/U}{R}{R}, merging it under Peregrine Drake.
The Peregrine Drake mutated creature's ability from Vadrok triggers, casting Quasiduplicate from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Quasiduplicate, creating a token copy of the Peregrine Drake mutated creature with haste.
The token copy of the Peregrine Drake mutated creature triggers, untapping five lands you control.
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, returning the nontoken Peregrine Drake and Vadrok from the battlefield to your hand and untapping two lands you control.
Cast Vadrok for its mutate cost by paying {1}{W/U}{R}{R}, merging it under the token Peregrine Drake mutated creature.
The token Peregrine Drake mutated creature triggers once for each of its Vadrok abilities.
Resolve one of these triggers, casting Quasiduplicate from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Quasiduplicate, creating a token copy of the Peregrine Drake mutated creature with haste.
The token copy of the Peregrine Drake mutated creature triggers, untapping five lands you control.
Resolve a second trigger from step 7, casting Snap from your graveyard without paying its mana cost, targeting the mutated creature that includes the nontoken Vadrok.
Resolve Snap, returning Vadrok from the battlefield to your hand as well as multiple token creatures which cease to exist, and untapping two lands you control.
Resolve any remaining triggers from step 7, casting any noncreature cards with mana value 3 or less that were not already cast since step 7 from your graveyard without paying their casting costs.
Repeat from step 6, adding one additional token Vadrok to each new iteration of the Peregrine Drake mutated creature token.

864-3622-4766-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Eternal Witness.
Eternal Witness dies, triggering Deathrender, putting Gravedigger from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Gravedigger enters the battlefield, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Eternal Witness' power.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Gravedigger.
Gravedigger dies, triggering Deathrender, putting Eternal Witness from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Gravedigger from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 5, causing target player to mill cards equal to Gravedigger's power.
Repeat.
